# Changelog

## [0.1.1-casein.1] - 2026-08-10

### Fixed
- Prefer QR metadata objects over the first non-QR barcode when multiple
  symbologies fire in one camera frame (DairyPhone #457).
- Honor the formats JSON argument so `formats: [:qr]` arms only QR decoding.
